chunks: Ali ibn Ibrahim, from his father, from al-Nawfali, from al-Sakuni, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) who said:
The Messenger of God (peace be upon him and his family) said: 'From the good fortune of a person is a righteous wife.'

key_terms.الزوجة الصالحة: The righteous/pious wife — a woman of virtue, faith, and good character
key_terms.سعادة: Good fortune, happiness — in Islamic thought this encompasses both worldly blessings and spiritual well-being (sa'adah)

ai.seo_question: What did the Prophet Muhammad say about the qualities of a good wife?
ai.summary: Imam al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) transmits this prophetic hadith in which the Prophet Muhammad (SAWW) identifies a righteous and virtuous wife as one of the great blessings and marks of good fortune for a man. In classical Islamic ethical literature, the concept of 'sa'adah' (happiness/good fortune) encompassed both worldly well-being and spiritual flourishing, and the companion of one's life was understood to be central to achieving this. This teaching reflects the Prophet's emphasis on the family unit as a foundation of social and spiritual stability.

en.hubeali:
Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father, from Al Nowfaly, from Al Sakuny, 
Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said:
‘Rasool-Allah<sup>saww</sup> said: ‘From the good fortune of the person is the righteous wife’.
en.sarwar: 4. Ali ibn Ibrahim has narrated from his father from al-Nawfaliy from al-Sakuniy who has said the following: “Abu ‘Abd Allah, Alayhi al-Salam, has said that the Messenger of Allah, O Allah, grant compensation to Muhammad and his family worthy of their services to Your cause, has said, ‘
Having a virtuous wife is a good fortune that a man enjoys.’”
